name: blocked_point
description: A service point is physically blocked mid-run
seed_discipline: run under a fixed seed; cite the run ID
mechanism: policy knobs bay_fault_rate_per_tick / bay_fault_outage_min (twin.ottoq_sim_bay_fault_handler); direct form: stalls.equipment_config['bay_fault'] with repair_at
expected_kernel_behavior: reconciliation sweep releases nothing it shouldn't; decide path routes around the blocked bay; bookings honour-or-replan slides reservations; no booking lands on the blocked point
